description: Reference year of the Survey of Household Spending, stored as January 1 of that year (2023-01-01 is the 2023 reference year). The survey ran every year from 2010 to 2017 and every two years since, so 2018, 2020 and 2022 do not exist.

Geography as published: Canada, Atlantic Region, Prairie Region and the ten provinces. The official notes say Canada level figures cover the 10 provinces only; the territories are not included. The household type file has Canada only.
Statistics Canada Dissemination Geography Unique Identifier for the geography.
Statistic as published. Average expenditure per household in every row.

Spending category exactly as published, from Total expenditure down to detailed items such as Rent or Restaurant meals. Categories are nested, so do not add a category to the categories it belongs to.
Official member ID of the spending category in the table metadata, also the last part of coordinate. Added here from the official metadata, not a separate official column.

The category this category belongs to, from the official metadata parent member ID (for example Food purchased from stores belongs to Food expenditures). Empty for Total expenditure. Added here, not a separate official column.

Depth of the category in the official hierarchy: 0 for Total expenditure, 1 for Total current consumption, Income taxes, Personal insurance payments and pension contributions, and Gifts of money, support payments and charitable contributions, 2 for the main consumption groups such as Food expenditures or Shelter, and so on down to 7. Added here from the official metadata, not a separate official column.
Unit of measure for value, as published: Dollars in every row.
Statistics Canada numeric code for the unit of measure.
Scale of value as published: units in every row, so 105367 means 105,367 dollars per household per year.
Statistics Canada numeric code for the scalar factor.
Statistics Canada vector identifier for the series. Useful if you want to pull the same series again.
Statistics Canada coordinate string that locates the series inside the official table.

Average expenditure per household in dollars for the reference year, as published. Empty when Statistics Canada did not publish a figure (status F or ..). Discounts and refunds is published as a negative amount. Official values were not altered.

Statistics Canada status symbol. F means too unreliable to be published (the official notes say estimates with a coefficient of variation of 35% or more are suppressed) and .. means not available for that reference year; for both the value is empty. Empty status means a regular published value.
Additional Statistics Canada symbol when present. Empty in all three files in this snapshot.

t if Statistics Canada has terminated this series, otherwise empty. 64 categories are terminated in this snapshot, with their last values in 2019 or earlier, mostly because the 2019 questionnaire combined or dropped some items.
Number of decimal places Statistics Canada uses when displaying the value.
